Connect Ostrel Built by Navy Website ostrel.test Category Alerts, Email Docs Ostrel setup guide Contact Navy support About the Ostrel integration Support usually hears about an outage from customers. With Ostrel connected, the incident lands in the support inbox as soon as Navy confirms it, with a ready answer the team can send while engineers work on the fix. Key features One conversation per incident: Every update is added as an internal note, not a new email. Auto tagging: Tag conversations with the affected component. Saved replies: Insert the current incident summary into any reply. Auto close: Close the incident conversation when the monitor is back up. Get started In Navy, open Settings, then Alerts, and choose Ostrel. Connect your account, pick an inbox and decide which monitors should open a conversation. For help, read
